compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: Complete rewrite of data access layer required. All DbContext classes, entity configurations, LINQ queries, and database operations must be migrated to EF Core 8.
issues.description: The application uses EntityFramework 6.2.0 which is NOT compatible with .NET 8. Entity Framework 6 only supports .NET Framework and cannot be migrated to .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace EntityFramework 6.2.0 with Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0 and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0. Migrate DbContext from System.Data.Entity to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore. Update all entity configurations to use IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 Not Compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging statements must be updated. Replace ILog with ILogger<T> throughout the application. Remove log4Net.xml configuration file.
issues.description: The application uses log4net 2.0.10 which is a legacy logging framework not recommended for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 8.0.0 or Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Update all ILog references to ILogger<T>. Configure logging in Program.cs using builder.Logging.
issues.title: log4net 2.0.10 Legacy Logging Framework

issues.impact: Complete refactoring of dependency injection configuration. Remove IContainerProviderAccessor interface. Migrate ApplicationModule to use IServiceCollection extension methods.
issues.description: The application uses Autofac.Web 4.0.0 which provides System.Web integration that is not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace Autofac.Integration.Web with built-in .NET 8 dependency injection or Autofac for ASP.NET Core. Register all services in Program.cs using builder.Services. Update ContainerProvider pattern to use ASP.NET Core DI.
issues.title: Autofac 4.9.1 Web Integration Not Compatible

issues.impact: Complete rewrite of UI layer required. All .aspx pages must be converted to Razor Pages (.cshtml) or MVC views. All code-behind files must be converted to PageModel or Controller classes.
issues.description: The application extensively uses System.Web namespace which is NOT available in .NET 8. Found references in multiple files including Global.asax.cs, all page code-behind files, and master pages.
issues.recommendation: Remove all System.Web references. Replace with ASP.NET Core equivalents: System.Web.UI.Page → PageModel (Razor Pages) or Controller (MVC), System.Web.HttpContext → Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext, System.Web.Optimization → WebOptimizer or built-in bundling.
issues.title: System.Web References Throughout Application

issues.impact: All HttpContext.Current references (4 occurrences found) must be replaced with dependency-injected IHttpContextAccessor.
issues.description: The application uses HttpContext.Current static property which does not exist in ASP.NET Core/.NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace HttpContext.Current with IHttpContextAccessor. Inject IHttpContextAccessor into services/pages and use HttpContext property. For session state, configure distributed cache or use TempData.
issues.title: HttpContext.Current Usage

issues.impact: Application startup logic must be completely rewritten. Dependency injection configuration, routing, and database initialization must be moved to Program.cs.
issues.description: Global.asax with Application_Start, Application_BeginRequest, and Session_Start events is Web Forms-specific and not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Program.cs with WebApplicationBuilder. Move Application_Start logic to Program.cs before app.Run(). Replace Application_BeginRequest with middleware. Remove Session_Start and use distributed cache or cookies.
issues.title: Global.asax Application Events

issues.impact: All configuration access via ConfigurationManager must be replaced with IConfiguration. HTTP modules and handlers configuration must be converted to middleware registration.
issues.description: Web.config is the Web Forms configuration system which is replaced by appsettings.json in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Create appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json. Migrate connection strings to ConnectionStrings section. Migrate appSettings to root or custom sections. Use IConfiguration and Options pattern for accessing settings.
issues.title: Web.config Configuration System

issues.impact: Session state access pattern changes. All Session["key"] usage must be updated to HttpContext.Session.GetString/SetString with proper serialization.
issues.description: Session state usage with InProc mode. ASP.NET Core session works differently and requires explicit configuration.
issues.recommendation: Configure session in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddSession(). Consider using distributed cache (Redis, SQL Server) for production. Alternatively, replace session state with TempData, cookies, or stateless design.
issues.title: Session State with InProc Mode

issues.impact: Complete removal of HTTP module-based DI. Implement proper constructor injection in Razor Pages or Controllers.
issues.description: HTTP modules are used for Autofac Web Forms integration. HTTP modules don't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace HTTP modules with ASP.NET Core middleware. Implement middleware pipeline in Program.cs. Use built-in dependency injection or configure Autofac for ASP.NET Core using AddAutofac().
issues.title: HTTP Modules for Autofac Integration

issues.impact: Complete rewrite of DbContext. All entity configurations must be updated from fluent API to EF Core syntax. Database initialization strategy must be replaced with migrations.
issues.description: CatalogDBContext inherits from System.Data.Entity.DbContext which is EF6-specific and not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Update OnModelCreating to use EF Core's ModelBuilder. Replace EntityTypeConfiguration<T> with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Update connection string configuration to use DbContextOptions.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 DbContext with System.Data.Entity

issues.impact: Database initialization strategy must be completely replaced. Seed data logic must be migrated to EF Core patterns.
issues.description: Database.SetInitializer is an EF6 feature that doesn't exist in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with EF Core migrations. Use EnsureCreated() or RunMigrationsAsync() in Program.cs. Implement database seeding using HasData() in entity configurations or custom migration.
issues.title: Database.SetInitializer for EF6

issues.impact: All 7 .aspx pages must be converted to Razor Pages or MVC. Complete rewrite of page lifecycle and event handling required.
issues.description: All page code-behind files inherit from System.Web.UI.Page which doesn't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor Pages with PageModel base class or MVC Controllers. Create .cshtml Razor Pages with corresponding PageModel classes. Implement OnGet/OnPost methods instead of Page_Load and button click events.
issues.title: System.Web.UI.Page Base Class

issues.codeSnippet:
<asp:TextBox ID="Name" runat="server" CssClass="form-control"></asp:TextBox>
<asp:RequiredFieldValidator runat="server" ControlToValidate="Name" Display="Dynamic" />
issues.impact: All server controls must be replaced with HTML/Tag Helpers. Validation controls must be replaced with data annotations and client-side validation libraries.
issues.description: Extensive use of ASP.NET server controls which don't exist in .NET 8. Found in all .aspx pages.
issues.recommendation: Replace with HTML5 input elements and Tag Helpers. Use asp-for, asp-validation-for tag helpers in Razor Pages. Implement client-side validation using jQuery Validation or FluentValidation.
issues.title: ASP.NET Server Controls (asp:TextBox, asp:DropDownList, etc.)

issues.impact: Master page logic must be migrated to Layout page with Razor syntax. All content placeholder references must be updated.
issues.description: Application uses Site.Master for layout which is Web Forms-specific. Found 1 master page.
issues.recommendation: Convert master pages to Razor _Layout.cshtml. Move ContentPlaceHolder regions to @RenderBody() and @RenderSection(). Update all pages to use @layout directive or configure globally in _ViewStart.cshtml.
issues.title: Master Pages (.master files)

issues.impact: User control must be converted to Partial View or View Component depending on complexity.
issues.description: Application contains ViewSwitcher.ascx user control which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: Convert user controls to Partial Views (_PartialView.cshtml) or View Components for more complex logic. Use @Html.Partial() or <partial> tag helper to render.
issues.title: User Control (.ascx file)

issues.impact: All Page_Load logic must be moved to OnGet/OnGetAsync methods. IsPostBack checks must be removed as Razor Pages handles GET/POST separately.
issues.description: All pages use Page_Load event which is Web Forms page lifecycle. Not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace Page_Load with OnGet/OnGetAsync in Razor Pages PageModel. Use OnPost/OnPostAsync for form submissions. Access route parameters via RouteData or method parameters with [FromRoute] attribute.
issues.title: Page Lifecycle Events (Page_Load)

issues.impact: All Response.Redirect calls must be replaced with appropriate redirect methods. Tilde (~) path resolution works differently.
issues.description: Direct use of Response.Redirect which has different behavior in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with RedirectToPage() or RedirectToAction() in Razor Pages/MVC. Use return RedirectToPage("Index") pattern. For external redirects, use Redirect() method.
issues.title: Response.Redirect Usage

issues.impact: Model binding must be reimplemented using [BindProperty] and proper PageModel properties with data annotations.
issues.description: ModelState usage in Web Forms pages without model binding attributes.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, use [BindProperty] attribute and data annotations for model binding and validation. Check ModelState.IsValid in OnPost handler before processing.
issues.title: ModelState.IsValid from Web Forms

issues.impact: BundleConfig.cs must be replaced with WebOptimizer configuration or removed entirely. Update all bundle references in views.
issues.description: Uses legacy bundling and minification library not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with WebOptimizer for ASP.NET Core or use built-in bundling. Alternatively, use webpack, gulp, or npm scripts for client-side asset management. Update _Layout.cshtml to reference bundled assets.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization for Bundling

issues.impact: All logging statements must be updated. Found 3+ files with log4net usage (Global.asax.cs, Default.aspx.cs, Create.aspx.cs).
issues.description: Static ILog logger instances using LogManager.GetLogger() throughout the application.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ILogger<T> injected via constructor. Configure logging in Program.cs using builder.Logging.AddConsole(), AddDebug(), or add Serilog. Update all _log.Info/Debug/Error calls to use ILogger methods.
issues.title: log4net ILog Static Logger

issues.impact: All route configuration must be migrated to ASP.NET Core routing. Friendly URLs and custom routes must be reimplemented.
issues.description: Web Forms routing using RouteConfig and RouteTable.Routes which doesn't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with ASP.NET Core endpoint routing. Configure routes in Program.cs using app.MapRazorPages() or app.MapControllers(). Use attribute routing or conventional routing with MapControllerRoute.
issues.title: RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes with RouteTable

issues.impact: All script references must be updated to standard <script> tags. MSAjax library must be removed or replaced with modern JavaScript.
issues.description: Uses ASP.NET ScriptManager for JavaScript management which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager. Reference JavaScript files directly in _Layout.cshtml using <script> tags. Use LibMan, npm, or CDN for client-side library management. Configure WebOptimizer for bundling if needed.
issues.title: ScriptManager and Script Bundling

issues.impact: All pages with property-injected dependencies must be updated to use constructor injection. Found in multiple page classes.
issues.description: Services are injected via public properties using Autofac.Integration.Web which doesn't work in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace property injection with constructor injection. Update all PageModel/Controller classes to receive dependencies via constructor. Register services in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddScoped/AddTransient/AddSingleton.
issues.title: Property Injection via Autofac Web Integration

issues.codeSnippet:
var itemsOnPage = db.CatalogItems
    .Include(c => c.CatalogBrand)
    .Include(c => c.CatalogType)
    .OrderBy(c => c.Id)
    .Skip(pageSize * pageIndex)
    .Take(pageSize)
    .ToList();
issues.impact: Verify all Include() statements work correctly in EF Core. Update namespace from System.Data.Entity to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.
issues.description: Uses EF6 Include() syntax which has different behavior in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to EF Core Include(). The syntax is similar but may have different behavior for complex scenarios. Test all queries thoroughly. Consider using AsNoTracking() for read-only queries to improve performance.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 Include() for Eager Loading

issues.impact: Update all entity modification patterns. The pattern works in EF Core but may need adjustment for disconnected scenarios.
issues.description: Uses EF6 pattern for updating entities which works differently in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: In EF Core, use Update() method or attach entity and modify properties. Consider using Update(entity) or explicitly set modified properties. Ensure entity tracking is configured correctly.
issues.title: EntityState.Modified for Updates

issues.impact: All data binding code must be removed from PageModel. Views must be updated to use Razor syntax for iteration.
issues.description: Uses Web Forms data binding pattern with DataSource property and DataBind() method.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, pass data via PageModel properties and use foreach loops or @foreach in Razor syntax. Remove DataBind() calls. Use @Model.Data directly in the view.
issues.title: Data Binding with DataSource and DataBind()

issues.impact: All ConfigurationManager references must be replaced. Found 2 occurrences in Global.asax.cs.
issues.description: Uses ConfigurationManager for accessing app settings which doesn't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with IConfiguration. Inject IConfiguration into services/classes. Access settings using configuration["UseMockData"] or use Options pattern with IOptions<T>.
issues.title: ConfigurationManager.AppSettings

issues.codeSnippet: PaginationNext.NavigateUrl = GetRouteUrl("ProductsByPageRoute", new { index = Model.ActualPage + 1, size = Model.ItemsPerPage });
issues.impact: All route URL generation must be updated to use ASP.NET Core URL helpers.
issues.description: Uses Page.GetRouteUrl() which is Web Forms-specific routing.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Url.Page() helper in Razor Pages. Use asp-page and asp-route-* tag helpers for generating links. Example: Url.Page("Index", new { index = index, size = size }).
issues.title: GetRouteUrl for Pagination URLs

issues.impact: Update to ApplicationInsights 2.21.0+ for .NET 8. Migrate from ApplicationInsights.config to appsettings.json and code configuration.
issues.description: Uses old ApplicationInsights packages (2.9.1) which may not be optimized for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to latest ApplicationInsights packages compatible with .NET 8. Use Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore instead of Web-specific packages. Update ApplicationInsights.config to code-based configuration in Program.cs.
issues.title: ApplicationInsights Legacy Package Versions

issues.impact: All entity configuration methods must be refactored to implement IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> interface.
issues.description: Uses EF6 EntityTypeConfiguration<T> which is replaced in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> interface. Create separate configuration classes implementing IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Apply configurations using modelBuilder.ApplyConfiguration(new EntityConfiguration()).
issues.title: EntityTypeConfiguration<T> Fluent API

issues.impact: All relationship configurations must be updated. Found multiple occurrences in entity configurations.
issues.description: Uses EF6 HasRequired() method which is replaced in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with HasOne().WithMany().HasForeignKey() in EF Core. Update all relationship configurations to use EF Core fluent API syntax. Test cascade delete behavior as it may differ.
issues.title: HasRequired() Relationship Configuration

issues.impact: Route parameter access must be updated to ASP.NET Core patterns.
issues.description: Accessing route parameters via Page.RouteData.Values which works differently in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, use [BindProperty(SupportsGet = true)] or method parameters with [FromRoute] attribute. Access via HttpContext.GetRouteData() or inject parameters directly into OnGet method.
issues.title: Page.RouteData.Values Access

issues.impact: All button click handlers must be converted to OnPost methods. Found in Create, Edit, Delete pages.
issues.description: Uses button click event handlers (Create_Click) which is Web Forms postback pattern.
issues.recommendation: Replace with OnPost/OnPostAsync handler methods in Razor Pages. Use [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] attribute. Return IActionResult from handler methods (e.g., return RedirectToPage()).
issues.title: Button Click Event Handlers

issues.codeSnippet: <asp:RequiredFieldValidator runat="server" ControlToValidate="Name" Display="Dynamic" CssClass="field-validation-valid text-danger" ErrorMessage="The Name field is required." />
issues.impact: All validation controls must be replaced with data annotations and tag helpers. Found in Create.aspx and likely Edit.aspx.
issues.description: Uses ASP.NET validation controls which don't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Replace with data annotations ([Required], [Range], etc.) on PageModel properties. Use asp-validation-for tag helper in views. Include jQuery validation scripts for client-side validation.
issues.title: ASP.NET Validators (RequiredFieldValidator, RangeValidator)

issues.impact: All database operations should be converted to async. Service interface must be updated to return Task<T>.
issues.description: Uses synchronous ToList(), SaveChanges() methods. .NET 8 best practices recommend async operations.
issues.recommendation: Replace with async/await pattern. Use ToListAsync(), SaveChangesAsync(), FirstOrDefaultAsync(). Update all service methods to return Task<T>. Update controllers/page models to await async methods.
issues.title: Synchronous Database Operations

issues.impact: Remove IDisposable implementation from services. DbContext will be managed by DI container.
issues.description: CatalogService implements IDisposable for DbContext disposal which is handled by DI in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove Dispose method from service classes. Register DbContext as scoped in DI container. Let the DI container handle DbContext lifecycle. Services should not own or dispose DbContext.
issues.title: Dispose Pattern in Service Classes

issues.impact: Upgrade Autofac packages and update registration syntax for ASP.NET Core compatibility.
issues.description: Using Autofac 4.9.1 which may not be optimized for .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: If continuing with Autofac, upgrade to Autofac 7.0+ for .NET 8. Use Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection for ASP.NET Core integration. Consider using built-in DI if Autofac features aren't required.
issues.title: Autofac 4.9.1 May Need Upgrade

issues.impact: Complete project file restructure required. Convert from legacy .csproj to SDK-style format.
issues.description: Project targets .NET Framework 4.7.2 which must be changed to net8.0.
issues.recommendation: Convert project to SDK-style .csproj format. Change TargetFramework to net8.0. Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web as SDK. Remove AssemblyInfo.cs as properties are handled by project file.
issues.title: Target Framework v4.7.2

issues.impact: All SelectMethod usages must be replaced with explicit data population in PageModel.
issues.description: Uses SelectMethod attribute on DropDownList for data binding which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: In Razor Pages, populate dropdown data in OnGet method and bind using asp-items tag helper. Use SelectList or List<SelectListItem> for dropdown options.
issues.title: SelectMethod for Data Binding

issues.impact: Enable proper request validation and implement anti-forgery tokens.
issues.description: Page directive disables request validation which could allow XSS attacks.
issues.recommendation: Remove ValidateRequest attribute. In .NET 8, use [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] attribute and proper input encoding. Use @Html.Encode() or automatic encoding in Razor. Review if HTML input is actually needed.
issues.title: ValidateRequest="false" on Create Page

issues.impact: Optionally migrate to System.Text.Json or upgrade Newtonsoft.Json to latest version.
issues.description: Uses older Newtonsoft.Json version. .NET 8 includes System.Text.Json as default.
issues.recommendation: Consider migrating to System.Text.Json for better performance. If Newtonsoft.Json is required, upgrade to version 13.0.3+. Add Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.NewtonsoftJson if needed for MVC/API.
issues.title: Newtonsoft.Json 12.0.1

issues.impact: Remove bundling configuration and update asset references in layout.
issues.description: Uses Bundle.config for script/style bundling which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: Remove Bundle.config. Use WebOptimizer, LibMan, or npm for asset management. Reference scripts/styles directly in _Layout.cshtml or use bundling middleware.
issues.title: Bundle.config File

issues.impact: Replace log4net context properties with modern logging correlation patterns.
issues.description: Uses log4net LogicalThreadContext for correlation which should be replaced.
issues.recommendation: Use ILogger scopes or Activity API for correlation. Implement correlation using HttpContext.TraceIdentifier. Use Serilog's enrichers for request context.
issues.title: LogicalThreadContext for Log4net

issues.impact: Part of overall Web Forms to Razor Pages conversion.
issues.description: All controls use runat="server" which is Web Forms-specific and not needed in Razor.
issues.recommendation: Remove all runat="server" attributes when converting to Razor Pages. Razor syntax doesn't require this attribute. Use Tag Helpers instead.
issues.title: runat="server" Attribute Throughout

issues.impact: Part of master page to layout page conversion.
issues.description: Uses ContentPlaceHolder which is master page-specific.
issues.recommendation: Replace with @RenderBody() for main content in _Layout.cshtml. Use @RenderSection() for optional sections. Define sections in pages with @section SectionName { }.
issues.title: ContentPlaceHolder for Master Page Sections

issues.impact: Update all script references to use standard HTML or tag helpers.
issues.description: Uses Scripts.Render() for script bundling which is Web Forms-specific.
issues.recommendation: Replace with standard <script> tags or Tag Helpers. Use <script src="~/lib/modernizr/modernizr.js"></script>. Configure LibMan or npm for client library management.
issues.title: Scripts.Render() Helper

issues.impact: Replace ListView with standard Razor iteration syntax.
issues.description: Uses asp:ListView server control for rendering product list.
issues.recommendation: Replace with @foreach loop in Razor syntax. Iterate over Model.Data and render HTML directly. Use partial views for list items if needed.
issues.title: ListView Control for Product List

recommendations: Migrate from Entity Framework 6.2.0 to Entity Framework Core 8.0.0 immediately. This is a critical blocker. Create new DbContext inheriting from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Migrate all entity configurations to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Convert Database.SetInitializer to EF Core migrations. Test all database operations thoroughly after migration.

Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging or Serilog.AspNetCore. Update all ILog references to ILogger<T>. Configure logging in Program.cs. This is required for .NET 8 compatibility and modern logging patterns.

Remove Autofac.Web integration and migrate to ASP.NET Core built-in DI or Autofac for ASP.NET Core. Replace property injection with constructor injection throughout the application. Register all services in Program.cs.

Convert all 7 .aspx pages to Razor Pages (.cshtml with PageModel). Convert Site.Master to _Layout.cshtml. Migrate all page lifecycle events (Page_Load) to OnGet/OnPost handlers. Replace all server controls with HTML5 + Tag Helpers. This is the largest effort item.
Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json. Replace ConfigurationManager with IConfiguration. Convert HTTP modules to middleware. Move all configuration logic from Global.asax to Program.cs.

Evaluate session state usage (currently storing MachineName and SessionStartTime). Consider removing if not essential, or migrate to distributed cache for production scalability. Configure session in Program.cs if needed.

Replace ASP.NET validation controls with data annotations and client-side validation. Use [Required], [Range], etc. on model properties. Include jQuery validation scripts. Use asp-validation-for tag helpers.
Migrate RouteConfig to ASP.NET Core endpoint routing. Configure in Program.cs using app.MapRazorPages(). Update all GetRouteUrl() calls to Url.Page() helpers. Test pagination routing thoroughly.

Remove Bundle.config and Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization. Use WebOptimizer or standard script/style references. Configure LibMan for client library management. Update _Layout.cshtml with new asset references.
Convert all synchronous database operations to async/await. Update service methods to return Task<T>. Use ToListAsync(), SaveChangesAsync(), etc. Update all page handlers to async methods.

Implement Clean Architecture with separate projects: Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Web. Create entity interfaces, service interfaces, repository pattern, and DTOs following the upgrade rules provided.
Create comprehensive test projects (unit tests and integration tests) for the migrated application. Test data access, business logic, and page handlers. Ensure >80% code coverage.
